external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A customer organization using the invoicing service as a tenant.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant
external_entities.notes: Represents the customer organization rather than an individual user.

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app; users are admins or viewers.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: May be an admin or a viewer.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The recipient of an invoice email who can view the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
external_entities.notes: The payer is not required to sign in.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: An agent who works from the support office network and uses the admin console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
external_entities.notes: Each agent signs in with their own account and a one-time code.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared application used by customer users to manage invoices, customers, payout bank details, payment pages and PDF requests.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: The app applies the company filter itself and uses one database account for all companies.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A renderer that consumes render jobs, reads invoices and writes PDFs to the PDF bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
processes.notes: It trusts the company ID carried by each job.

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: A console used by support agents to open billing-app sessions as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
processes.notes: The admin console is reachable only from the support office network.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column; the database has no row-level security. Protection at rest was not recorded.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs with a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_stores.notes: The queue's protection and access path were not recorded.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket storing rendered PDFs under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs with one service credential for all companies. Protection at rest was not recorded.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A customer user signs in to the billing app with an email address and password and receives a session cookie.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They sign in with an email address and a password and get a session cookie.
data_flows.data_description: Email address, password and session cookie

data_flows.name: use app
data_flows.description: A customer user uses the billing app in a browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers and payout bank details

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: A payer follows the invoice link and views the invoice, company name and bank details on the payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details
data_flows.notes: The payer is not asked to sign in.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name and bank details

data_flows.name: send invoice email
data_flows.description: The billing app sends an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number to the payer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice link containing the invoice number

data_flows.name: read and write invoices
data_flows.description: The billing app reads and writes invoices, customer records and payout bank details in the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers and payout bank details

data_flows.name: request PDF
data_flows.description: A customer user asks the billing app for a PDF of an invoice.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Any user can ask for a PDF of any invoice, as often as they like.

data_flows.name: enqueue job
data_flows.description: The billing app places a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue
data_flows.notes: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.

data_flows.name: take job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads the invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a rendered PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF, company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: fetch PDFs
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket using one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies

data_flows.name: deliver PDF
data_flows.description: The billing app delivers a fetched invoice PDF to a customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Any user can ask for a PDF of any invoice
data_flows.notes: The text states that the billing app fetches PDFs but does not describe the delivery protocol.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console with an account and a one-time code.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code

data_flows.name: open session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as any customer user on behalf of a support agent.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Subsequent actions are recorded against the customer user rather than the agent.

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: The customer-company tenant boundary, controlled by a party distinct from the service operator.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud-platform network location containing the shared billing app, tenant database and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents can reach the admin console.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database is confidential because it contains invoices, customer records and payout bank details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the database contains every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket is confidential because it stores rendered invoice PDFs containing business, personal and financial information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the bucket stores PDFs rendered from invoices and that the payment page contains company bank details.
